vibe_rationale: Long-running, community-trusted yoga and conscious-living gathering in Ubud with strong curation, but a single wellness scene rather than a mixed subculture.
fit_notes: The strongest wellness fit here: health-conscious adults, a deep returning community and health partners already on the roster (Healthy Ubud, AQUA). Australians were the largest source of Bali arrivals in 2025 (23.44 per cent, BPS Bali), but the event's Australian share is not published, so test it first.
